items.name: Classic Car Collection
items.description: Wyman's Ultimate Edition commission: track down abandoned classic and work-in-progress project cars and their parts around Leonida, then have mechanic Wyman restore them into drivable vehicles.

sources.title: Ultimate Edition - Grand Theft Auto VI
GTA 6 pre-orders open, and here's what's in the Ultimate Edition

items.name: Spaceship Parts
items.description: Fifty UFO-themed novelty parts scattered across San Andreas in GTA V; press coverage expects a similar find-the-pieces set in GTA 6.

items.name: Letter Scraps
items.description: Fifty scattered paper pieces that assemble into a killer's letters in GTA V; press coverage expects a similar novelty collectible in GTA 6.

items.name: Hidden Packages
items.description: One hundred hidden packages shaped like tiki statues in GTA Vice City, with a reward for every ten found and all of them needed for 100% completion. Press coverage expects hidden packages in GTA 6.

sources.title: Hidden Packages - GTA Vice City Side Missions Guide

items.name: Sunken Treasure
items.description: Hidden caches of cash on the sea floor, found with a submarine's sonar in GTA Online. Previews say scuba diving in GTA 6 lets you search for treasure, including in shipwrecks.
